prompt: Many years ago, this ______ train was approaching a bridge.
hint: Look at the word 'this' right before the blank.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used because 'this' is already a demonstrative determiner modifying 'train'.
explanationNp: 'this' आफैमा Determinative भएकाले 'this' पछि कुनै पनि Article (-) प्रयोग हुँदैन।

prompt: While traveling through the valley, we crossed a bridge over ______ river.
hint: Singular countable noun mentioned for the first time.
explanationEn: 'a' is used before 'river' because it starts with a consonant sound (/r/) and is mentioned for the first time in a general sense.
explanationNp: 'river' व्यञ्जन ध्वनि (Consonant Sound) बाट सुरु भएको र पहिलो पटक आएकाले 'a' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: As the train sped down the track, ______ driver noticed a strange figure ahead.
hint: Refers to the specific driver operating the train in context.
explanationEn: 'the' is used because it refers to the specific driver operating the train mentioned in the sentence context.
explanationNp: वाक्यको सन्दर्भले तोकेको चालक (driver) भएकाले 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Looking through the fog, the driver saw ______ strange figure standing ahead on the track.
hint: Unknown or unspecified figure introduced for the first time.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'strange' starts with a consonant sound (/str/) and introduces an unspecified entity for the first time.
explanationNp: 'strange' व्यञ्जन ध्वनिबाट सुरु हुने र पहिलो पटक आएकाले 'a' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: When the conductor pulled the emergency lever, the noise of ______ brakes was terrible.
hint: Refers to the specific brakes of the train being discussed.
explanationEn: 'the' is used to specify the particular brakes of the train in this scenario.
explanationNp: तोकिएको रेलको ब्रेक भएकाले निश्चित रूपमा 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Before leaving the room, he took his ______ lamp and walked out into the dark.
hint: Look at the possessive pronoun 'his' before the blank.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used directly after possessive pronouns like 'his', 'her', or 'my'.
explanationNp: Possessive pronoun ('his', 'my', 'her') पछि तुरुन्तै कुनै Article (-) प्रयोग हुँदैन।

prompt: He walked ______ few steps along the path to inspect the damage.
hint: Set phrase indicating a small number.
explanationEn: 'a few' is a fixed expression meaning a small number of items.
explanationNp: 'a few' एउटा निश्चित वाक्यांश (Phrase) हो जसको अर्थ 'केही' हुन्छ।

prompt: She didn't recognize ______ boy in the blue shirt standing near the gate.
hint: Specific boy modified by the phrase 'in the blue shirt'.
explanationEn: 'the' is used because 'in the blue shirt' specifies exactly which boy is being identified.
explanationNp: नीलो सर्ट लगाएको खास केटा (specific boy) को कुरा भएकाले 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Hari is ______ honest boy who always tells the truth.
hint: Pay attention to the initial sound of 'honest'.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'honest' starts with a silent 'h' and a vowel sound (/ɒ/).
explanationNp: 'honest' को पहिलो अक्षर 'h' भए पनि स्वर ध्वनि (Vowel Sound - 'अ') बाट उच्चारण हुने भएकाले 'an' लाग्छ।

prompt: His father works as ______ University professor.
hint: Pay attention to the initial sound of 'University'.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'University' starts with a consonant sound (/juː/).
explanationNp: 'University' अक्षर 'U' बाट सुरु भए पनि व्यञ्जन ध्वनि ('यु') आउने भएकाले 'a' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Copper is ______ useful metal used in electrical wiring.
hint: Sound check for 'useful'.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'useful' begins with a consonant sound (/juː/).
explanationNp: 'useful' को उच्चारण व्यञ्जन ध्वनि ('यु') बाट हुने भएकाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: She will return in ______ hour after completing her meeting.
hint: Silent letter rule.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'hour' has a silent 'h' and begins with a vowel sound (/aʊər/).
explanationNp: 'hour' मा 'h' Silent रहने हुनाले स्वर ध्वनि ('आ') बाट सुरु हुन्छ, त्यसैले 'an' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: ______ Sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
hint: Unique natural object.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before unique astronomical and natural objects.
explanationNp: ब्रह्माण्डमा एउटै मात्र भएका अद्वितीय वस्तुहरूको अगाडि 'the' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: Mount Everest is ______ highest peak in the world.
hint: Superlative degree adjective 'highest'.
explanationEn: 'the' is always used before superlative adjectives (e.g., highest, tallest, best).
explanationNp: Superlative degree ('highest', 'best') को अगाडि सधैँ 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He plays ______ guitar very well during music sessions.
hint: Musical instrument rule.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before the names of musical instruments when referring to playing them.
explanationNp: बाजा (Musical Instruments) बजाउने कुरा गर्दा अगाडि 'the' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: ______ Bagmati is a sacred river in Nepal.
hint: Names of rivers.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before proper names of rivers, seas, and oceans.
explanationNp: नदी, समुद्र र महासागरको नाम अगाडि 'the' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: He bought ______ M.A. degree form yesterday.
hint: Abbreviation starting with a vowel sound.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because the abbreviation 'M.A.' starts with a vowel sound (/ɛm/).
explanationNp: 'M.A.' को उच्चारण गर्दा स्वर ध्वनि ('एम') आउने भएकाले 'an' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: My uncle works as ______ S.P. in Nepal Police.
hint: Abbreviation sound check.
explanationEn: 'an' is used because 'S.P.' starts with a vowel sound (/ɛs/).
explanationNp: 'S.P.' को उच्चारण गर्दा स्वर ध्वनि ('एस') बाट सुरु हुने हुनाले 'an' लाग्छ।

prompt: They live in ______ United States of America.
hint: Country name containing 'United'.
explanationEn: 'the' is used for countries whose names contain words like 'United', 'Kingdom', or 'Republic'.
explanationNp: 'United', 'Kingdom', वा 'Republic' जोडिएका देशका नाम अगाडि 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: ______ water in this glass is dirty.
hint: Uncountable noun made specific by location ('in this glass').
explanationEn: 'the' is used with uncountable nouns when they are specified or limited to a particular container or location.
explanationNp: यस गिलासको तोकिएको पानी (specific water) को कुरा भएकाले 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: I like ______ milk for breakfast every morning.
hint: General uncountable noun.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before uncountable nouns used in a general sense.
explanationNp: साधारण अर्थमा Uncountable Noun (दूध, चिया) को कुरा गर्दा कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: Yesterday I saw ______ European tourist near Swayambhu.
hint: Initial sound of 'European'.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'European' starts with a consonant sound (/jʊərəˈpiːən/).
explanationNp: 'European' को उच्चारण 'यु' (Consonant Sound) बाट हुने भएकाले 'a' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He gave me ______ one-rupee note.
hint: Initial sound of 'one'.
explanationEn: 'a' is used because 'one' starts with a consonant sound (/wʌn/).
explanationNp: 'one' को उच्चारण 'व' (Consonant Sound) बाट हुने हुनाले 'a' लाग्छ।

prompt: ______ Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal.
hint: Proper noun / name of a city.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before proper names of cities, countries, or people.
explanationNp: शहर, देश वा मानिसको नाम (Proper Noun) अगाडि कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: She reads ______ Bhagavad Gita every morning.
hint: Religious scriptures and holy books.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before names of holy religious books.
explanationNp: धार्मिक ग्रन्थहरू (जस्तै: Gita, Bible, Quran) को नाम अगाडि 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: ______ rich should help the poor in times of difficulty.
hint: Adjective used as a noun group.
explanationEn: 'The' placed before an adjective converts it into a plural noun representing the entire group.
explanationNp: 'The rich' ले संसारभरिका सबै धनी मानिसहरूको समूहलाई बुझाउँछ।

prompt: He is ______ taller of the two brothers.
hint: Comparative degree used for selection between two.
explanationEn: 'the' is used before a comparative adjective when pointing out selection between two options.
explanationNp: दुईजना बीच तुलना गरेर एकजना छान्दा Comparative degree अगाडि 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: ______ English is spoken all over the world.
hint: Language name without the word 'language'.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before language names unless followed by the word 'language'.
explanationNp: भाषाको नाम (English, Nepali) को अगाडि Article (-) प्रयोग हुँदैन।

prompt: ______ English language is widely spoken around the globe.
hint: Language name followed explicitly by 'language'.
explanationEn: 'The' is used when the word 'language' explicitly follows a language name.
explanationNp: भाषाको नाम पछि 'language' शब्द जोडिएर आएमा अगाडि 'The' लाग्छ।

prompt: She goes to ______ church every Sunday to pray.
hint: Primary purpose of visiting an institution.
explanationEn: No article (-) is used before places like school, church, or hospital when used for their primary purpose.
explanationNp: प्रार्थना गर्न चर्च जाँदा (प्राथमिक उद्देश्य) कुनै Article (-) लाग्दैन।

prompt: The workman went to ______ church to repair the roof.
hint: Secondary/other purpose of visiting a building.
explanationEn: 'the' is used when visiting a building like a church or school for a purpose other than its primary function.
explanationNp: मर्मत गर्न वा अर्कै कामले चर्च जाँदा (द्वितीयक उद्देश्य) 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: What ______ beautiful flower this is!
hint: Exclamatory sentence with singular countable noun.
explanationEn: 'a' is used in exclamatory structures starting with 'What' before singular countable nouns.
explanationNp: 'What' बाट सुरु हुने विस्मयादिबोधक वाक्यमा 'a/an' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: Match stem: 'It's already 11.30. The last bus may have left ______'
hint: Expectation at the current moment.
explanationEn: 'by now' denotes an expected completed action at the current moment.
explanationNp: 'by now' ले अहिलेसम्ममा गाडी छुटिसकेको हुनसक्छ भन्ने समय जनाउँछ।

prompt: Match stem: 'Most of the time our cat stays ______'
hint: Location phrase inside a residence.
explanationEn: 'inside the house' specifies the location where the cat resides.
explanationNp: 'inside the house' ले बिरालो घरभित्र बस्छ भन्ने स्थान जनाउँछ।

prompt: Match stem: 'Hari's test result was ______'
hint: Comparison phrase showing top performance across the nation.
answer: among the best in the country
explanationEn: 'among the best in the country' is a prepositional phrase showing high ranking.
explanationNp: 'among the best in the country' ले देशकै उत्कृष्टमध्ये एक भन्ने अर्थ दिन्छ।

prompt: Match stem: 'In order to finish my assignment, I had to work all ______'
hint: Duration phrase covering continuous night time.
explanationEn: 'through the night' indicates continuous effort throughout the night hours.
explanationNp: 'through the night' ले रातभरि निरन्तर काम गरेको जनाउँछ।

prompt: Match stem: 'All their lives, Rabin and Rina have lived ______'
hint: Location phrase indicating proximity.
explanationEn: 'near each other' describes geographic closeness between two subjects.
explanationNp: 'near each other' ले एक-अर्काको नजिक बसेको जनाउँछ।

prompt: Match stem: 'Can you pass me my keys? I think they're on ______'
hint: Surface location phrase.
explanationEn: 'on the table' is the standard prepositional phrase for objects resting on a surface.
explanationNp: सतहमा राखिएका वस्तुका लागि 'on the table' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Match stem: 'It was a perfect holiday, ______'
hint: Exception phrase excluding bad weather.
explanationEn: 'apart from' functions as a preposition meaning 'except for'.
explanationNp: 'apart from' को अर्थ 'बाहेक' (except for) हुन्छ।

prompt: I will have visited Denmark ...... end of this year.
hint: Deadline phrase used with Future Perfect tense.
explanationEn: 'by the end of' indicates a deadline for a future completed action.
explanationNp: Future Perfect tense मा 'by the end of' (वर्षको अन्त्यसम्ममा) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: I bought those books ...... they were interesting.
hint: Conjunction expressing reason or cause.
explanationEn: 'because' introduces a clause giving a reason for the main action.
explanationNp: कारण (Reason) देखाउनका लागि 'because' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: I am sure, there ...... be somebody else in the room.
hint: Modal verb for strong logical deduction/certainty.
explanationEn: 'must' is used for strong probability or logical deduction.
explanationNp: पक्का अनुमान वा निश्चितता (Certainty) बुझाउन 'must' को प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: I ...... (attend) the party if they had invited me.
hint: Third Conditional formula: if + past perfect, would have + V3.
explanationEn: Third conditional requires 'would have + V3' in the main clause.
explanationNp: Third Conditional मा Main Clause मा 'would have + V3' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: The books ...... (bring) before he left the house.
hint: Past perfect passive: had been + V3.
explanationEn: The action occurred before another past action, requiring Past Perfect Passive.
explanationNp: अतीतको अर्को कामभन्दा पहिले भएको कर्मवाच्य (Passive) मा 'had been + V3' लाग्छ।

prompt: Ranju ...... (complete) her M Phil by 2085 B.S.
hint: Future completion deadline: will have + V3.
explanationEn: Future deadlines marked with 'by + future time' take Future Perfect tense.
explanationNp: भविष्यको तोकिएको समयसम्म काम सकिने हुनाले Future Perfect ('will have completed') लाग्छ।

prompt: She is very fond ______ listening to classical music.
hint: Fixed adjective preposition pattern.
explanationEn: The adjective 'fond' is always followed by the preposition 'of'.
explanationNp: 'fond' शब्दपछि सधैँ Preposition 'of' को प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He prevented me ______ entering the examination hall.
hint: Fixed verb preposition pattern.
explanationEn: Verbs of stopping/preventing take 'from + -ing verb'.
explanationNp: 'prevent' जस्ता रोक्ने अर्थ दिने शब्दपछि 'from + -ing' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: He worked hard ...... he could pass the examination.
hint: Conjunction expressing purpose.
explanationEn: 'so that' expresses purpose followed by a subject + modal verb clause.
explanationNp: उद्देश्य (Purpose) प्रकट गर्न 'so that' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: You ...... respect your elders and teachers.
hint: Modal verb for moral duty or social obligation.
explanationEn: 'ought to' or 'should' expresses moral duty.
explanationNp: नैतिक कर्तव्य (Moral Duty) बुझाउन 'ought to' वा 'should' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: Divide these sweets ...... the four children.
hint: Distribution among three or more individuals.
explanationEn: 'among' is used when distributing or placing among three or more people.
explanationNp: तीन वा सोभन्दा बढी मानिसहरू बीच बाँड्दा 'among' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: There is a negotiation going on ...... Nepal and India.
hint: Relationship/interaction between exactly two parties.
explanationEn: 'between' is used when referring to two distinct entities.
explanationNp: दुईवटा देश वा पक्षको बीचमा कुरा गर्दा 'between' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He has been living in Kathmandu ...... 2018.
hint: Starting point of time for Present Perfect Continuous.
explanationEn: 'since' specifies a specific starting point in time.
explanationNp: निश्चित सुरुवात समय (Point of time) का लागि 'since' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: She has been studying ...... three hours.
hint: Duration/period of time.
explanationEn: 'for' specifies a duration or quantity of time.
explanationNp: समयको अवधि (Period of time) जनाउन 'for' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: The cat jumped ...... the table.
hint: Preposition showing movement onto a surface.
explanationEn: 'onto' indicates movement ending on a surface.
explanationNp: गतिशीलता (Movement) देखाउँदै सतहमा पुग्दा 'onto' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: He died ...... cholera last week.
hint: Cause of death by disease.
explanationEn: Die + 'of' + disease (e.g., died of cancer, died of cholera).
explanationNp: कुनै रोगका कारण मृत्यु हुँदा 'die of' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: She accused him ...... stealing her purse.
hint: Fixed verb pattern for charge/allegation.
explanationEn: 'accuse someone of something' is a fixed collocation.
explanationNp: 'accuse' शब्दपछि सधैँ 'of' लाग्छ।

prompt: Walk carefully ...... you should fall down.
hint: Conjunction warning of a negative consequence.
explanationEn: 'lest' means 'for fear that' and is followed by 'should'.
explanationNp: 'lest' को अर्थ 'नत्र/कतै...होला' हुन्छ र यसपछि 'should' आउँछ।

prompt: She is not only intelligent ...... also hardworking.
hint: Correlative conjunction pair.
explanationEn: 'not only' pairs with 'but also'.
explanationNp: 'not only' को जोडी सधैँ 'but also' हुन्छ।

prompt: ...... I come in, sir?
hint: Formal permission request.
explanationEn: 'May' is used for formal polite permission requests.
explanationNp: शिष्टाचार र औपचारिक अनुमति माग्दा 'May' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

prompt: A new bridge ...... (build) over the river right now.
hint: Present continuous passive: is being + V3.
explanationEn: 'right now' indicates present continuous passive action.
explanationNp: अहिले भइरहेको कामको कर्मवाच्य (Passive) मा 'is being + V3' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it ...... (boil).
hint: Zero conditional scientific fact.
explanationEn: Zero conditional (general facts) uses Simple Present in both clauses.
explanationNp: वैज्ञानिक सत्य कुरामा Zero Conditional (Simple Present) प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: If I were you, I ...... (accept) the offer.
hint: Second conditional hypothetical advice.
explanationEn: Second conditional uses 'would + V1' in the main clause.
explanationNp: काल्पनिक अवस्था वा सल्लाह (Second Conditional) मा 'would + V1' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Rearrange: arrive / the principal / to / on time / the teachers / expected
hint: Formula: Subject + Verb + Object + Infinitive Phrase.
answer: The teachers expected the principal to arrive on time
explanationEn: Subject (The teachers) + Verb (expected) + Object (the principal) + Infinitive (to arrive on time).
explanationNp: कर्ता 'The teachers', क्रिया 'expected', र Infinitive 'to arrive' सही क्रम हो।

prompt: Rearrange: new employees / to / is planning / hire / the company
hint: Formula: Subject + Auxiliary Verb + Main Verb + Object.
answer: The company is planning to hire new employees
explanationEn: Subject (The company) + Verb (is planning) + Infinitive (to hire) + Object (new employees).
explanationNp: कर्ता 'The company', क्रिया 'is planning', र Infinitive 'to hire' हो।

prompt: Rearrange: to / next year / graduate / expects / Barbara
hint: Formula: Subject + Verb + Infinitive + Time.
answer: Barbara expects to graduate next year
explanationEn: Subject (Barbara) + Verb (expects) + Infinitive (to graduate) + Time phrase (next year).
explanationNp: कर्ता 'Barbara' अगाडि र समय 'next year' अन्त्यमा आउँछ।

prompt: Rearrange: to / require / their medical exams / all hospitals / pass / doctors
hint: Formula: Subject + Verb + Object + Infinitive Phrase.
answer: All hospitals require doctors to pass their medical exams
explanationEn: Subject (All hospitals) + Verb (require) + Object (doctors) + Infinitive (to pass...).
explanationNp: कर्ता 'All hospitals' र क्रिया 'require' पछि कर्म 'doctors' आउँछ।

prompt: Rearrange: a / language / foreign / we / to / learn / decided
hint: Formula: Subject + Verb + Infinitive + Object.
answer: We decided to learn a foreign language
explanationEn: Subject (We) + Verb (decided) + Infinitive (to learn) + Object (a foreign language).
explanationNp: कर्ता 'We', क्रिया 'decided', र Infinitive 'to learn' हो।

prompt: Rearrange: dress appropriately / job applicants / the office / to / for their interviews / advised
hint: Formula: Subject + Verb + Object + Infinitive Phrase.
answer: The office advised job applicants to dress appropriately for their interviews
explanationEn: Subject (The office) + Verb (advised) + Object (job applicants) + Infinitive (to dress...).
explanationNp: कर्ता 'The office', क्रिया 'advised', र उद्देश्य अन्त्यमा राखिन्छ।

prompt: Rearrange: teacher / hard / the / work / the students / made
hint: Causative verb formula: Subject + made + Object + V1.
answer: The teacher made the students work hard
explanationEn: Causative 'make' takes a bare infinitive (V1 without 'to'): Subject + made + Object + V1.
explanationNp: Causative verb 'make' पछि Bare Infinitive (V1) को प्रयोग हुन्छ।

prompt: Rearrange: easily / solved / the problem / the clever boy
hint: Formula: Subject + Verb + Object + Adverb.
answer: The clever boy solved the problem easily
explanationEn: Subject (The clever boy) + Verb (solved) + Object (the problem) + Adverb (easily).
